results.Summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Silverado EV work trucks.  The pedestrian alert sound system may not produce sound at a sufficient volume.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."
results.Consequence: A vehicle that fails to make sufficient sound may result in pedestrians being unaware of an approaching vehicle, increasing the risk of injury.
results.Remedy: Dealers will update the software in the body control module (BCM), free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 22, 2025.  Owners may contact Chevrolet customer service at [REDACTED_PHONE].  GM's number for this recall is N242483530.
results.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at [REDACTED_PHONE] (TTY [REDACTED_PHONE]) or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
